snippet.title: Grit and Valor: 1949 VR - Official Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
Build your mech squad in Grit and Valor: 1949 VR, and check out this latest trailer for another look at gameplay and learn about the world of this upcoming action strategy game. Grit and Valor: 1949 will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and Epic Games Store on August 21, 2025. A VR edition of the game will be available for PC, PlayStation 5, and PS VR2 on August 21, 2025. It will also be available to purchase separately on the Meta Quest store.


Grit and Valor: 1949 is set in an alternate-history World War II, where players command an elite squad of resistance mech pilots against the technologically superior forces of the Evil Axis.
